| Prefer locals over fields, fields over module state, and module state over globals (`skills/principle-minimize-reader-load/SKILL.md:14`) | Separate Before Serializing Shared State asks whether concurrent actors need the same mutable object and eliminates the sharing before serializing access (`.agents/skills/principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state/SKILL.md:9`, `:15`) |

| Name the invariant at the boundary, not in every consumer, so the reader learns it once (`skills/principle-minimize-reader-load/SKILL.md:15`) | Boundary Discipline exposes domain concepts at the boundary and trusts internal code (`.agents/skills/principle-boundary-discipline/SKILL.md:16`), and Type System Discipline validates once at creation and trusts the type downstream (`.agents/skills/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:11`) |
| Before adding a layer or a piece of state, ask whether it reduces reader load elsewhere by at least as much (`skills/principle-minimize-reader-load/SKILL.md:16`) | Refactoring step 7 reverts a diff whose reader load is not lower (`.agents/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/refactoring.md:13`), Codebase Design adds a seam when two adapters justify it (`.claude/skills/codebase-design/SKILL.md:65`), and Model the Domain is skeptical of an abstraction that adds indirection without removing branches (`.agents/skills/principle-model-the-domain/SKILL.md:22`) |
| The test: a new reader answers "where does X come from?" and "what can change X?" in under 30 seconds, else cut layers or cut state (`skills/principle-minimize-reader-load/SKILL.md:18`) | nothing |

| Usual cause: an expected value computed by the code under test (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:13`) | nothing |
| Usual cause: a restated constant or prompt string that never runs the code that reads it (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:13`) | nothing |
| Usual cause: an assertion on data that the test built itself (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:13`) | nothing |
| Change the internals while every observable result stays the same, and a test that now goes red is pinned to the implementation (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:14`) | `.agents/skills/tdd/SKILL.md:17` has the test encode intended behavior rather than mirror the current implementation, and `.agents/skills/tdd/SKILL.md:26` lists a test that encodes implementation details among the bad tests |
| A test pinned to the implementation needs a rewrite on every refactor and catches no bug (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:14`) | nothing |
| Keep a test that catches the first edit and survives the second (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:16`) | `CODING_STANDARDS.md:29` requires every test to be able to go red and to catch something no other test catches |
| Rewrite or delete the rest (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:16`) | `CODING_STANDARDS.md:29` has the tests that catch nothing else deleted |
| Drive the code through its users' interface with a concrete input (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:16`) | Tests import the exported functions and call them with literal arguments (`ops/build-runner/test/worker-policy.test.mjs:5-18`, `ops/build-runner/test/evidence-review.test.mjs:36-43`); `CODING_STANDARDS.md:21` checks unit tests through appropriate interfaces |
| Derive the expected value from the requirement, not from a run of the code (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:16`) | The criteria test expects the three Acceptance criteria bullets of the saved card, read from the card text in the fixture (`ops/build-runner/test/evidence-review.test.mjs:17-43`) |
| Assert what the contract promises, no less and no more (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:16`) | `docs/plans/path-forward.md:42` keeps one automated test per feature, with nothing else to keep in step |
| The contract decides, not the shape of the assertion (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:18`) | nothing |
| "An empty cart never charges" makes an assertion that the payment client got no call behavior (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:18`) | nothing |
| Pair it with a case where the charge happens, so the test shows it can see a call (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:18`) | nothing |
| The payload a mocked external service receives is behavior, since that service observes it (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:18`) | `scripts/check-no-fakes.mjs:2-4` refuses a test that names an outside service and replaces it with a local server, mock, stub, fake or offline fixture; `CODING_STANDARDS.md:21` states that mocked provider responses alone cannot prove provider behavior |
| A call to an internal helper is implementation, since no user can see it (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:18`) | nothing |
| An empty list is the exact answer when no record matches, and a hollow check when the test needs some result (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:18`) | The repository-level test asserts the exact empty list as the answer when nothing is reported (`scripts/no-fakes-repository.test.mjs:6-8`) |

| The error type that callers branch on is the contract (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:18`) | nothing |
| A test can pin an invariant instead of a call, such as a key that must exist in two tables or a compile-time type check (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:20`) | `scripts/no-fakes-repository.test.mjs:6-8` pins the repository-wide invariant that no tracked test stands in for an outside service |
| The invariant is the behavior (`skills/principle-test-behavior-not-implementation/SKILL.md:20`) | `AGENTS.md:30-32` gives each enforced invariant a named script, and CI runs those scripts (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:22-29`) |
